en: Welcome to the Aspertia Gym. I'm Cheren, its Leader. Well... I suppose I'm still a Leader in training.
This is your first Gym challenge, and it's my very first battle as a Gym Leader.
That battle made me really glad you were my first challenger.
Here is your first Gym Badge, the Basic Badge. It's an important first step. Wear it with pride!
{player} received the Basic Badge from Cheren!
Take this too. Use it however you think best.
There are eight Gyms in Unova, and eight Badges. Where you go from here is up to you, {player}.
Don't worry about losing your way. You have your Pokémon beside you.
We have a challenger! If you can beat my two pupils first, I'll be your opponent.
I hope you'll always remember the moment you received that Badge.
Hello! I'm Clyde, guide to every Trainer who takes on a Pokémon Gym. Thanks for taking this one on!
Here, have this to mark the occasion.
Gyms test what Trainers can do. Beat the Leader, and you'll have proved yourself a strong Trainer!
If every Pokémon you have faints, you lose. So it helps to bring a few along!
I hope you'll always remember the moment you won that Badge!
